MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is an efficient and reliable storage solution specifically designed for MikroTik routers and servers. With 32GB of storage, this SSD offers ample space for operating system files, network configurations, software updates, and logs, ensuring smooth and reliable performance for your networking needs. Designed to work with Legacy BIOS boot mode, this SSD is compatible with older MikroTik systems, making it a versatile solution for various setups. It is built to integrate seamlessly with PC MikroTik machines and supported MikroTik server machines, ensuring easy installation and optimal performance. The SSD comes pre-installed with RouterOS v6.48, a powerful network operating system offering advanced routing, security, and network management features. The device offers flexibility with OS version update and downgrade support, allowing users to keep the system up-to-date with RouterOS v6.49.14 or revert to previous versions as needed. This ensures compatibility with evolving network demands and provides users with full control over their system's software environment. Pre-activated with a MikroTik Level 6 license, this SSD unlocks advanced features, such as dynamic routing, robust firewall security, VPN services, and more. The Level 6 license is ideal for users who require enhanced control and functionality for their network infrastructure. Additionally, the MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD includes technical support and warranty coverage, offering peace of mind and reliable assistance whenever needed. Available in various capacities, including 16GB, 32GB, 64GB, and 128GB, this SSD provides scalable storage options based on your network’s requirements. Overall, the MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD is a cost-effective, high-performance storage solution, designed to enhance the capabilities of MikroTik routers and servers, offering excellent value and dependability for networking professionals.
